name: Way of the Sun Soul
summary: Monks who hurl bolts of radiant energy.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.short: Ranged radiant attacks that work with Martial Arts.
features.summary: You gain a ranged spell attack (30 ft.) dealing radiant damage equal to your Martial Arts die + DEX. You can use it in place of attacks from the Attack action, and spend 1 ki to make two of them as a bonus action.

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.short: After attacking, spend 2 ki to cast Burning Hands.
features.summary: Immediately after you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast Burning Hands as a bonus action, spending extra ki to raise its level.

features.name: Searing Sunburst
features.short: Action: a 20 ft. orb of light, 2d6 radiant (more with ki).
features.summary: As an action, create an orb of light at a point within 150 ft.; creatures in a 20 ft. sphere make a CON save or take 2d6 radiant damage. Each extra ki point (up to 3) adds 2d6.

features.name: Sun Shield
features.short: Glow with light; melee attackers take radiant damage.
features.summary: You shed bright light in a 30 ft. radius. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal radiant damage equal to 5 + WIS.
